_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it: history lists your reels in order, projects maps a reel id to its project folder, and each element's reels say where it was used. Empty history = nothing used yet.
_about_components: house = the packaging, colour roles and drawing grammar (every reel); hook / scene / emphasis / transition / outro are NEW every reel (components.py plan --style telestrator)

elements.desc: corner bug from frame 0: yellow show block (house.json packaging.show) + a mode line ● LIVE (red) / ANALYSIS (yellow) / REPLAY (cyan)
source clock: ▶ running / ❚❚ yellow on a freeze / ◀◀ counting back, true reel time and frame number (F116)
matchup bar bottom right (no numbers): the yellow leader block sits on one side and flips once on the payoff word with a yellow flash
the speaker's words as one-line subtitle chunks (Inter Tight 600 52 px, black 0.64 bar, 4 px yellow left edge), names corrected on screen
between segments only: a yellow slanted band with dark edges crossing in 0.34 s, the cut on its midpoint
a freeze: a still of the exact plate frame, the flash + spotlight + zones behind the speaker's cutout (same frame + matte), the drawings on top; no punch or grade on the speaker
the ring: perspective ellipse (ry 0.36 r) drawn clockwise with a pop, an outer dashed ring creeping at 60 px/s, fill 0.16
marker line: dark outline + glowing core + white highlight drawn along its length, arrowhead on the last 10 %, 2 px wobble; dashed (separate dashes revealed in order) = intended path
label: black card, 10 px role-colour bar, Inter Tight 900 + spaced Oswald line, clip reveal left to right with a tick
dark board #0C1411 with a 60 px chalk grid; the line's object is played, frozen and drawn on it
spotlight: the background outside a focus ellipse darkens to 0.42 in 0.3 s, behind the speaker's cutout only
frame 0: live play with the stopwatch running and a ring already drawn under the speaker's hand (the hook reads as analysis at once)
freeze on the word that names an object: ring under the hand, a dashed (hypothetical) outline of the object in the hand, a dashed arrow from the label that names it
the book the speaker names as a tactics board: the real cover with cyan rings on its marks and the yellow ring on its verdict, the author label
the reel's one stamp (the gist in two words) drops 1.7x -> 1x rotated on the word that says it
a drawn phone on the board: notifications stream in live, freeze, cyan rings on the ones the speaker names, yellow marker strikes, a label with the instruction
rewind: the board's objects run back with jitter, tracking bars, ◀◀ REWIND, the clock counting back; then a clean screen with a ring and the speaker's side of the matchup
freeze on the word that names a tool: ring under the hand, its icon drawn on the wall beside the speaker, a dashed (future) arrow from hand to icon, a two-line label
summary board: three rows land on the speaker's words with oblique yellow numerals, marker underlines and chalk icons (moon, a run route from a ring, two linked rings)
dual-angle split: wide | tight windows (1:1 slices, yellow divider, camera tags), both freeze on the feeling word, rings in both, a label that turns from the doubt to the resolution
freeze on the word about room or time: a red space zone behind the speaker's cutout (the room around them), a two-line label
flat ending: live to the last word; the matchup leader flips from the opponent to YOU on the payoff word

ideas_not_built_yet: a rewind of the speaker's own footage (a reversed piece of the plate with tracking bars): needs a reversed matte so the bars stay off the face
a slow-motion pass between two freezes (frame-blended 0.6-0.85x of the plate) with the frame-counting stopwatch
a tracked ring that follows the speaker's hand through live play (keyframes per 3-6 frames, like the source's TRK) when the hand moves
the perspective flatten: a freeze frame warping into a top-down board (the source's homography move); for a talking head, a desk or a whiteboard the speaker points at
a data card with counted numbers and one red marker circle: only with true, sourced numbers
the show sting at frame 0 (chalk lines + title stamp) when the first line can wait half a second
